name: Kannagi Yuuma
source:
A guy who's into poetry and quite an introvert. 
Lengthy hospitalization left Yuuma with a fear of crowds and prefers quietude. He's been head over heels for his twin sis, Yuuri, for as long as he can remember, and he can never defy her. Thanks to the twins looking like two peas in a pod, their [url=/c61163]Father[/url] coerced Yuuma to crossdress and go to an all-girls school, however...

"...So, you're saying I'm to blame?"
